title: When Reject Turns into Accept: Quantifying the Vulnerability of LLM-Based Scientific Reviewers to Indirect Prompt Injection
reasoning: The paper focuses on the security and integrity of scientific peer review against adversarial prompt injections. While its evaluation rubric includes an 'Ethics' criterion to assess research compliance in submissions, and it contains an 'Ethical Implications' section, the primary research goal is not to evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
